CustomProperties.Name: Filters
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Filter state from the screen. A RECORD, not a table: a record carries no data source so it does not materialise anything, and the QUERY LIVES INSIDE THIS COMPONENT so the galleries can page. Passing a table here would cap the table at the data row limit. Add a filter as a FIELD here rather than as a new component property. ShowDeleted is TWO STATE, active OR deleted, never both: IsDeleted = <variable> delegates, but IsDeleted = false || IsDeleted = true is an OR over a column and drops the whole Filter to the client.
